title: is_numeric() with trailing ASCII space
summary: As of PHP 8.0, is_numeric("42 ") returns true, PHP 7.x returns false.
applies: PHP 7.x and PHP 8.x; parameter is a string
detail: Also an ASCII space, " 42 " is evaluated as a numeric string in both version series, and the result of " 42 " changes across versions.
boundary: The range of whitespace here is not equal to all Unicode whitespace. The non-breaking space U+00A0 in the manual example does not apply.
relevance: When restoring the classification results of the text read in the question, even if they appear to be the same when printed, the remaining blank characters will affect the conclusion.
